description: As we enter the last few weeks of this election cycle, you'll have a few more opportunities to hear directly from your candidates. I encourage you to take part. If you have questions about who to vote for, get out and participate in the process. Meet them, ask questions, weigh whether or not they would be a good representative for you. I'll be on the road a lot this week giving voters all across Senate District 10 a chance to meet and talk with me. Join us at one of these stops: Tuesday, Oct. 20
title: Participate in the process
